spans.s:
मग m. a magian;
 pl. N. of a people.
मग॑ध m. pl. N. of a country and people.

मागध॑ f. ई relating to, coming from, or born among
the Magadhas. — m. a prince of the Magadhas, pl. N. of a people ( =
मगध) & a caste;
 f. आ a princess of the M., f. ई the same or
the language of the Magadhas.
मगधदेश m. the country of the Magadhas.
†मगुन्दी f. N. of the mother of cert. female demons.
